name: Moving House Checklist
description: A homeowner's moving house checklist covering meter readings, mail redirects and handover.

items.text: Confirm your moving date and book a removal company
Declutter and start a donate, sell and dispose pile
Get quotes for any work needed before or after the move
Start a folder for contracts, quotes and important documents
Notify utility providers (gas, electricity, water) of your move date
Arrange broadband and phone at the new address
items.note: Installation slots book up — schedule early

items.text: Update your address with banks, insurers, employer and subscriptions
Tell the council and update the electoral roll
Set up a mail redirect with your postal service
Confirm timings and access with your removal company
Pack an essentials box for the first night
Run down the freezer and pantry
Service or disconnect appliances you're taking
Arrange care for children and pets on moving day
Take final meter readings and photograph them
Do a final walkthrough of every room, loft and shed
Keep documents, valuables and chargers with you
Leave keys, manuals and bin days for the new owners
Lock up and confirm handover of keys
Submit opening meter readings to your new suppliers
Test smoke and carbon-monoxide alarms; locate the stopcock and fuse box
Register with a local doctor, dentist and the council
Check window and door locks; consider changing exterior locks
Update your address on your driving license and vehicle documents

faq.q: What should I do with utility meters when moving house?
faq.a: Take photos of the gas, electricity and water meter readings on moving day at both homes. Send final readings to your old suppliers and opening readings to your new ones to avoid being billed for someone else's usage.

faq.q: How do I redirect my post when moving house?
faq.a: Set up a mail redirect with your postal service a week or two before you move, then update your address with banks, employers, insurers, and subscriptions so important post reaches you.

faq.q: What should I leave for the new owners?
faq.a: Leave all keys, garage and gate remotes, appliance manuals, alarm codes, warranty paperwork, and bin-collection days. A short note on quirks of the house is a kind touch.

faq.q: Is this moving house checklist printable?
faq.a: Yes. Print it or download the PDF so you can carry it through completion day and tick off both the packing and the paperwork.
